name: Admin Proposal Send
description: Send a proposal from the list or edit page. The Correos tab is available while the proposal is a draft and saves the editable plain-text email_intro independently. Every send requires a nonblank message; the scorecard links back to Correos when it is missing. Delivery renders the predefined body, then the personalized problem-to-solution-to-outcome message, then commercial blocks, and attaches the proposal PDF. Backend returns email_delivery so the panel distinguishes delivery success from SMTP/template failure.
knownGaps: The server-side PDF-attachment side effect on send is backend-only and not asserted at the UI layer.
